sources.TWSE: MI_INDEX / STOCK_DAY_ALL (official daily close, volume in shares, amount in TWD)
sources.TPEX: dailyQuotes (official shares and TWD; legacy fallback converts 張/千元)
sources.TX: TAIFEX futDataDown, day session, front month by volume; week/month windows use that same contract
sources.TXF: TAIFEX nearest non-expiring month, night+day; upper/middle/lower from the 13:39:58 snapshot of the TAIFEX daily tick file (middle = (Q + snapshot VWAP)/2); week/month lines through the night session of the as-of day, C = night close
